title: Algorithm analysis of John Ward's Mars anomalies

tellings.quote:
I apply some algorithms
to evaluate that evaluate the likelihood
that they can be naturally formed
fractal and texture-based algorithms.

plain: A researcher who studies odd shapes on Mars ran computer tests on strange features that a man named John Ward picked out of photos taken by NASA's Mars Global Surveyor probe and the HiRISE camera that orbits Mars. The researcher, a guest of Michels, says he used "fractal and texture-based algorithms" to judge how likely it is that the shapes formed naturally. The point is to see whether any of them might have been made by someone.
